title: science(gravity): compile Record stress into metric reactions
science: Block 31: compiles a positive null-anchored sixteen-state Record family into all fifteen actual edge-source rays with positive rank-one Euclidean metric stress (83,521 exact product probabilities checked), splits the residual into nine shape channels plus one nonmetric branch lifted by the curvature-square action, and solves all 3,876 four-site count sources with a rank-25 metric-only KKT system.
